description: Search KW's current public catalogue by keyword, brand or exact model/SKU, with existing category, ex-GST price, website In Stock, sort and supported width filters. Returns at most 8 results, no pagination. Main prices include GST; ex-GST prices are also provided.

in_stock.description: Filter by the website's In Stock status; this is not a dispatch promise.

price_max.description: Maximum AUD excluding GST, matching the existing website search filter.

price_min.description: Minimum AUD excluding GST, matching the existing website search filter.

width_band.description: Existing website width band, applied only in supported categories.

name: search_products
